newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Friday, with trading volume thin as the country began the fasting month of Ramadan, traders said.
They said olein was generally quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta for prompt delivery, but offers were also heard at 1,440-45 rupiah. No crude palm oil deals were heard.
Olein prices are expected to trend stable to lower in the coming week on slow demand amid the Ramadan fasting month and expected continued government market operations, traders said.
The state logistics agency BULOG began market operations, selling olein at 1,300 rupiah per litre, on Tuesday aimed at keeping prices under control ahead of the Eid al-Fitr festival next month.
Ramadan, during which Moslems fast during daylight hours, ends with the Eid al-Fitr holiday celebrations due on February 9 and 10 in Indonesia.
